**Focus:** Game developers, gaming technologies, gaming services

**Check Size:** Seed-stage, first checks
**Stage:** Pre-seed to Seed
**Location:** New York, USA; Limassol, Cyprus
**Website:** https://www.gamesfund.vc

## Primary Contact
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name | Ilya Eremeev |
| Title | General Partner |
| Background | Gaming industry veteran; former 3D artist; co-founded fund's thesis |
| LinkedIn | Active |

## Investment Thesis
Founded by video game industry veterans. Invest in future leaders: game developers, gaming technologies, and services. Never too early — move fast and support from day one.

Layer.ai (AI content), Järvi Games, KEK Entertainment, Eschatology Entertainment (ex-Valve/Wargaming), Dark Passenger (ex-Witcher 3/CDPR), DRAMA Studios (Unrecord)

- Layer.ai investment shows AI tooling appetite
- Geographic diversity: US, Cyprus, Europe, Georgia

## Outreach Angle
Veterans backing veterans. Perfect fit for studios with strong technical teams. Layer.ai investment shows AI infrastructure interest.

## Draft Subject
"AI-powered live ops — veteran studio seeking veteran backers"

## Priority
P1 — Actively deploying; AI infrastructure thesis
